prompt: A traverse with a bearing of -30 degrees comes out wrong: azimuths should always land in 0–360. Find the cause and fix it.
Distances shown in feet in Distance & Bearing are far too small. Fix it.
New user environments are showing as rows instead of as groups beside .GlobalEnv. Fix it.
Exporting .GlobalEnv saves ouRGeo's own helpers instead of my objects. Fix it.
When the assistant writes map.addLayer(...) as R, nothing catches it any more and the user sees could not find function. Fix it.
Add an interface action the assistant can use, id plots:clearAll, that clears the plot history. It changes user state, so give it the right tier. Add a test.
Add a setting to Settings → Prompts: "Ask before clearing plots", on by default, persisted. No need to wire it to clearing yet.
Add a Toolbox tool that computes each polygon's area in square kilometres into a new column on an sf object, with the output name as a field.
Entering a leg in feet draws it far too short. Fix it.
Docking a panel into a pane says it is already there when it is not. Fix it.
Closing a panel from the toolbar opens it instead. Fix it.
Deleting the environment I was working in leaves the console pointed at it, and deleting another one kicks me back to .GlobalEnv. Fix it.
Permission overrides for assistant actions in Settings have no effect. Fix it.
The assistant can call terminal actions with the Terminal switch off, and is refused with it on. Fix it.
Yesterday's console history shows up after a clean restart. Fix it.
The assistant should be able to point at the Packages toolbar button with ui:highlight. Make that work.
Add an interface action, session:clearWorkspace, that removes the user's objects from .GlobalEnv. Follow the rules for actions that touch R.
Add a new action group "basemapPresets" with two actions: one lists saved basemap presets and one applies a preset by name. Stub the store if needed. Add tests.
Add a Browse Sources entry for the USGS earthquake GeoJSON feed (all_week). It should import with sf.
Add an assistant action that deletes a plot by index. Think about what tier deletion should have, and add a test that pins it.
Add a small dialog component that shows a plot's title and size, in the style of the app. Just the component.
Add an R endpoint POST /object/nrow that returns the number of rows of a named object, and a matching rClient method. A refusal must reach the caller as a body, not a thrown error.
Build the app, launch it, and save a screenshot of the Packages panel to shot-packages.png in the repo root.
Build and launch the app, run 1+1 in the R console, and save a screenshot showing the result to shot-console.png in the repo root.
